sources.title: Osmo Review: Genius & Coding Kits With Fun Math & Word Games for iPad
sources.snippet: # Osmo's learning kits are a fun way to introduce STEAM concepts to kids with engaging math and word games. * **Osmo's educational kits are beautifully designed and employ the family tablet to engage your kids with thoughtful activities.**. * **There's the Osmo Coding Kit ($99.99), Osmo Genius Starter Kit + Family Game Night ($139.99), and Little Genius Starter Kit + Early Math ($119.99).**. Osmo's thoughtfully designed educational kits are different. Most of what's in these kits is familiar, but Osmo recently bundled its coding games together with new durable pieces and unveiled fresh cooperative and competitive word and math games to encourage families to play together. Each Osmo kit comes with a stand for an iPad or Amazon Fire tablet and a special top piece with a mirror that slides over the front-facing camera. Each kit offers a different set of games that work with the kit's included pieces. ## Osmo Genius Starter Kit + Family Game Night. With seven different games to play, there's lots to do with the Genius Kit. My daughter particularly liked the Tangram game, which challenges kids to make the onscreen animals from geometric shapes. This kit is aimed at preschoolers, but we actually had some fun using the squiggly plastic pieces to create characters that came to life on screen in Squiggle Magic and to form letters in the ABC game. Osmo's new games in this kit are Counting Town and Shape Builder, both use the sticks and rings to form numbers or create shapes. The hook of onscreen action dictated by physical pieces is what makes Osmo's kits unique and both the hardware and software are highly polished. I appreciate that Osmo has made some effort with the new kits to introduce more cooperative and competitive play elements that can involve the whole family. Thoughtfully designed, easy to use, and engaging, Osmo's kits offer a rare blend of fun and education that has the potential to spark young imaginations. Ultimately, there's enough depth and versatility here, particularly in the Osmo Genius Starter Kit + Family Game Night, to keep kids coming back for more.
